cli.cmd.snapshot: dump the tail of a port buffer
cli.cmd.export: export buffered lines to a file
cli.cmd.reload: hot-reload the daemon config (optionally switch to another file)
cli.cmd.shutdown: stop the daemon: close all ports and exit (POST /api/shutdown)
cli.cmd.set_device: remap a port's device/match at runtime
cli.arg.send_data: payload; '-' reads stdin (one trailing newline stripped)
cli.arg.range: optional range selector for the daemon
cli.arg.config_reload: switch to another config file at runtime (path; memory only)
cli.arg.profile: tool profile: full (20 tools, default) | lite (8 compact tools: 6 serial + zsend/zrecv)
cli.cmd.tools: print the lite tool definitions (raw JSON array, not an envelope)
cli.desc.shutdown: Stop the running serialhub daemon, the same as the Web UI Exit button: active ZMODEM transfers are aborted, bridges stopped, every serial port closed and released, then the process exits. Refused when server.allow_shutdown is false.
cli.desc.tools: Print the eight lite tool definitions as one compact JSON array (not the usual {ok,data} envelope). Needs no running daemon.
cli.cmd.call: run one lite tool and print plain text (not an envelope)
cli.desc.call: Run one lite tool against the daemon and print its plain-text result (not the usual {ok,data} JSON envelope). Exit 1 when the text starts with 'error:'.
cli.arg.call_args: tool arguments as a JSON object (default {})
cli.arg.match: match spec: JSON object or k=v pairs (e.g. description=CH340,vid=0x1A86)
cli.arg.no_reopen: change the in-memory mapping only (no reopen now)
cli.error.match_not_object: invalid --match: expected a JSON object, got {text}
cli.error.match_pairs: invalid --match spec: {text!r} (expected k=v pairs or a JSON object)
server.error.no_reload_path: no config source path to reload from
server.error.bad_origin: cross-origin request refused (Origin does not match Host)
server.error.shutdown_unavailable: shutdown unavailable: this server was not started by `serialhub serve`
hub.error.set_device_usb: '{bad_key}' is not a valid usb id: {value!r}
hub.error.pins_disabled: pins disabled for port '{name}' (set ports[{name}].pins.enabled: true to control DTR/RTS)
hub.error.pins_bad_duration: duration_ms must be a non-negative integer, got {value!r}
hub.error.switch_no_path: config path must be a non-empty string
cli.cmd.zsend: upload file(s) to the device by ZMODEM (sends rz itself)
cli.desc.zsend: Upload local files, or --content TEXT --name NAME, to the device by ZMODEM through the daemon. Sends the rz command itself (use --cmd '' if the device is already waiting). Prints one line per file: sent <name> <bytes>B crc=<CRC32> in <s>s. Exit 1 on 'error:'.
cli.arg.zsend_content: file body to upload instead of files ('-' reads stdin)
cli.arg.zsend_name: device file name for --content (reduced to a basename)
cli.arg.zsend_encoding: encoding of --content: text (UTF-8, default) or base64
cli.arg.zsend_cmd: device command that starts the receiver (default rz; '' = none)
cli.arg.zm_timeout: overall timeout in ms (default: automatic from file size and baud; max 1800000)
cli.cmd.zrecv: download file(s) from the device by ZMODEM (sends sz itself)
cli.desc.zrecv: Download files from the device by ZMODEM through the daemon into --dir. Sends 'sz <remote>' itself. Prints one line per file: received <name> <bytes>B crc=<CRC32> -> <path>. Existing files are kept (new one saved as name.1, name.2, ...) unless --overwrite. Exit 1 on 'error:'.
cli.arg.zrecv_dir: local directory to save into (created if missing; default: current directory if writable, else the temp directory)
cli.arg.zrecv_overwrite: replace existing local files instead of saving name.1, name.2, ...
cli.arg.zrecv_inline: also print the content of text files (capped at 4000 chars)
cli.error.zsend_one: give file path(s) or --content, not both
cli.arg.zsend_no_overwrite: keep an existing device file (lrz then answers ZSKIP); default: overwrite
